name: Narrator
text: In a dim corner, Kyra finds a hunched figure muttering to himself, hands clasped tightly around a small dolphin statue as if in prayer.

name: Sam
text: You can’t escape… no one escapes…

name: Kyra
text: Why… why are you praying to that statue?

name: Sam
text: Because it listens! It hears us, it knows… it knows what we did…

name: Sam
text: Our intentions, dreams, nightmares.. it knows.. all of us..

name: Sam
text: and even if your life depended on it, you cannot overcome it..

name: Narrator
text: her eyes wide open from the fear, feels a chill run down her spine

name: Kyra
text: I am really sorry for.. whatever drove you to this state.. but..

name: Kyra
text: I really… really need that statue… once I get it…

name: Kyra
text: I will be able to go furter on my investigation of getting the hell out of here and save further victims.

name: Sam
text: Dolphins give me a state of comfort.. a comfort out of this immortal nightmare..

name: Kyra
text: if having a dolphin gives him a sense of comfort.

name: Kyra
text: I suppose I can put my sculpturing skills into practice, especially for a demonic occasion like this one.
